options.blogdescription: Remote preview of my block theme

steps.code:
<?php
$user = 'Agressiva86';
$repo = 'playground-test';
$theme_slug = 'playground-test-theme';

// 1. Download ZIP
$url = "https://github.com/$user/$repo/archive/refs/heads/main.zip";
$content = @file_get_contents($url);
if (!$content) return;
file_put_contents('/tmp/repo.zip', $content);

// 2. Extract ZIP
$za = new ZipArchive;
if ($za->open('/tmp/repo.zip') === TRUE) {
    $za->extractTo('/tmp/extracted');
    $za->close();
    
    // 3. Find theme folder
    $dirs = glob('/tmp/extracted/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR);
    if (!$dirs) return;
    $src = $dirs[0] . '/theme';
    if (!is_dir($src)) return;
    
    // 4. Define destination
    $dest = is_dir('/wordpress') ? '/wordpress/wp-content/themes/' : '/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/';
    $dest .= $theme_slug;
    
    // 5. Copy files
    if (!function_exists('move_theme')) {
        function move_theme($s, $d) {
            if (!is_dir($d)) mkdir($d, 0777, true);
            foreach (scandir($s) as $f) {
                if ($f === '.' || $f === '..') continue;
                if (is_dir("$s/$f")) move_theme("$s/$f", "$d/$f");
                else copy("$s/$f", "$d/$f");
            }
        }
    }
    move_theme($src, $dest);
} ?>
